solution: He and his friends were traveling in a hot-air balloon when it developed a problem and began losing altitude. They threw their luggage overboard, but the balloon was still too heavy. They drew matchsticks to decide who would be sacrificed. The man drew the broken matchstick and was thrown out of the balloon, still holding it.
